title: finding(docs/filter-ui): the Schema block's `type` union omits `multi-select`, which both published faces declare and `FilterUI` renders
body:
## Finding

`content/docs/components/complex/filter-ui.mdx`'s Schema block lists the `filters[]` entry's `type` union without `multi-select`. Both published faces declare it (`packages/types/src/views.ts` `FilterUISchema.filters[].type`, and the zod mirror in `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts`), and `packages/plugin-view/src/FilterUI.tsx` picks a control for it. The page under-teaches: an author reading it does not learn that a multi-select filter exists. It invites no wrong metadata, which is why it was left out of objectui#10611.

## Where it was found

Recorded on PR objectui#10760 by the dev (「Observation, not filed … Carrier: none」) and carried by the contract-review records 5853796261 (③ b) and 5856250843, which asked for a carrier so the gap does not rot silently. This card is that carrier; nothing in objectui#10760 changes for it.

## Fix

Add `multi-select` to the documented `type` union in the Schema block, matching the TS face member for member (re-read `views.ts` at the time of the fix; do not copy this card). Prose only, no code; the page's existing "Retired" paragraph about `operator` stays.

## Acceptance

- The Schema block's `type` union equals the `FilterUISchema.filters[].type` union on the TS face, member for member.
- `pnpm check:doc-types` (Doc Component Type Check) green.
- Changeset: none (docs page, not a package).

Clause-②: no
